items: Watch videos inside the app, and pick up where you left off.
Copy, Google, ChatGPT and Claude links on every question and concept.
Calmer screens: fewer boxes, one clear next step.
New calendar: month view, day agenda and a long agenda list, from Plan or Today.
Back button and swipe-back now work like a normal app.
Improved mobile layouts, keyboard spacing and readable text zoom.
Animation explainers can show limit holes, thin strips, circular motion and Venn sets.
New look: orange and black, chunky buttons and a learning path per chapter.
New tabs: Learn, Practice, Test and Review. Plan, Log and Stats are under your profile.
Timed quick tests, PYQ papers and a full 65-question mock with a calculator.
